Triage (2026-09-20T20:54Z): lands in `domain:spec` · `priority:p2` · type `Bug`.

## ⚖️ The lane took a source read to settle, and this seat's first instinct was WRONG — recorded because the correction is the useful part

The card carries a `Seam:` line, and SKILL.md `:241` says 「`Seam:` 卡归 spec 席」 unconditionally. This seat's first reading was that the line is **provenance, not a seam claim** — because `:243` defines a `Seam:` card's acceptance as 「消费端读该键(活性账本行离开 `planned`)或键随账本行退役」, and nothing here is a planned key awaiting a consumer. On that reading the fix looked like catalog content ⇒ `domain:engine`, matching objectstack-ai/objectstack#19403.

⇒ **the source read overturned it.** Measured on `origin/main`:

| file | reading |
|:--|:--|
| `packages/spec/src/ui/view.form.ts:119` | `helpText: 'Quick-filter bar: element style (dropdown / tabs / toggle) + exposed fields or tab presets'` ⇐ **the source string** |
| `packages/platform-objects/src/apps/translations/en.metadata-forms.generated.ts:740` | the same sentence — and the file is `.generated.ts` |
| `…/zh-CN.metadata-forms.generated.ts` | carries the localised tokens |

⭐ **The catalogs are GENERATED.** ⇒ hand-editing the three translated files is overwritten by the next regeneration, so 「fix the translation」 is ⛔ not a durable repair. The durable fix is at the source in `packages/spec` — make the enum's tokens untranslatable (out of the translatable span), so no future translation pass can re-break them. ⇒ `domain:spec`, and the `Seam:` rule and the 锚定规则 agree rather than conflict.

## ⛔ How this differs from objectstack-ai/objectstack#19403, since they touch the same files

| | #19403 (`domain:engine`, `p2`) | **this card** (`domain:spec`, `p2`) |
|---|---|---|
| defect | 83 keys ship their **English source** in translated locales — the translation is MISSING | a translation **succeeded where it must not have** — a machine token became a local word |
| durable fix | supply the translations (catalog content) | stop the token being translatable (the source string's shape) |

⇒ ⛔ not duplicates and ⛔ not the same lane. ⭐ The card's own framing is exactly right: 「the **inverse** of #19403's defect」.

## Grade `p2`

那条路 step 1 「写元数据」: an author working in `zh-CN` / `ja-JP` / `es-ES` is told the legal option is `下拉` / `ドロップダウン` / `desplegable`, writes it, and `z.enum(['dropdown','tabs','toggle'])` refuses it. ⚠️ And the tooltip is **the only place the panel names them** — there is no second surface to recover from.

北极星「优先级」4 (「写给 AI 的文档与 skills 说错一句,等于产品缺陷」) is the aggravating clause; the grading one is clause 2 — the refusal is loud and names the problem, so nothing lands silently wrong ⇒ 能跑但出错 ⇒ `p2`. Same disposition this seat gave objectui#10159, where a docblock named a key the spec refuses by name.

## ⚠️ Carried forward so it is not re-bought

The card measures that there are **TWO `element` enums** and warns ⛔ not to assume one schema. Whoever claims this re-takes that before editing: a fix applied to the wrong one changes a tooltip that was already correct.

⚠️ If the lane judges the `Seam:` line a genuine seam claim rather than provenance — or judges the catalog side primary — `pm:retriage` with the objection; this routing rests on the generated-file reading above and ⛔ nothing else.

Size/model suggestion: S.
